prompt: A bag has 5 red and 3 blue beads. Two are drawn without replacement. Given the first is red, find P(second red).
solution: One red was removed: 4 red among 7 remaining, so 4/7.

prompt: Independent events A and B have P(A)=0.4 and P(B)=0.3. Find P(A | B).
solution: Independence means P(A | B)=P(A)=0.4, since P(B)>0.
